edition_angle: Focusing on traditional botanical formulations and their cellular mechanisms in mitigating neuroinflammation and microglial communication in neurodegenerative decline.

assignments.angle: Investigating how Zhinao Capsules modulate CX3CL1/CX3CR1-centered neuron-microglia communication to protect synaptic integrity and alleviate cognitive impairment in Alzheimer's models.
assignments.reason: Provides a clear cellular mechanism (CX3CL1/CX3CR1 signaling axis and microglial-neuron communication) in a validated animal model (APP/PS1 mice) for Alzheimer's disease. It helps balance coverage toward Luminous Mind cellular signaling while avoiding pure epidemiological correlations.
